lessons.keep: Show the physical parts that correspond to each step in the mechanism.
lessons.avoid: Avoid expanding from a prototype explanation into broad health benefits without a shown evidence path.
lessons.open: Device performance, research applicability, physiological benefits, safety, exact stimulus timing, cognitive claims and all audio delivery remain unverified.
